parsed.name: ensemble_global_catalyst_book
parsed.strategy: Only names at least two independent lenses would pick: catalysts (a dated event inside Oct 12-Nov 13), revision flow (net analyst raises), power/grid bottleneck, policy, quality momentum, or Asia supply chain. The book concentrates in semicap/memory/foundry with confirmed Q3 prints, AI power and grid equipment with inflection flags, dated Q4 biotech PDUFAs, European defense names reporting inside the window, and uranium/gambling calendar names. I would be wrong if a single macro shock (hyperscaler capex digestion, China export controls, or a de-escalation headline) hits the correlated AI-power and defense sleeves at once, or if binary PDUFA names draw CRLs.
parsed.objective: Maximize relative P&L versus the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 with a long-only, catalyst-dated, multi-lens ensemble book.
